habitat-loss.def: The destruction or conversion of the places species live, by farming, logging, mining, roads and cities (habitat destruction). It is the leading cause of biodiversity loss.

hippco.def: An acronym for the main human threats to biodiversity: Habitat loss, Invasive species, Pollution, human Population growth, Climate change and Overexploitation.

wildlife-corridor.def: A strip or link of habitat, such as a forested strip, an overpass or an underpass, that connects fragments so animals can move between them (also called a habitat corridor).

mass-extinction.def: The loss of a large share of Earth’s species in a geologically short time. Five have occurred; today’s rapid losses may mark a sixth mass extinction.
